description: The always-on built-in tools and services every agent has from the first turn — time, date, math, attachments, persistent memory, session search, user/webhook registration, session naming (auto-titles chats after early turns), the self-improvement tools (an agent reading/improving its OWN prompt and teaching itself reusable skills), and the discovery tools that load everything else. These are wired into the agent directly and are NOT part of any ability, so they are listed here for reference and permission management. The discovery/skill plumbing (load_tool, load_ability, list_skills, load_skill) and the essential tier-1 utilities are locked 'always on'; memory, session search, the self-improvement tools and the webhook tools can be gated with the normal Deny/Ask/Auto permission. read_own_prompt/edit_own_prompt act only on the agent's OWN unlocked prompt sections (lock a section to protect it from self-editing); save_own_skill/remove_own_skill let the agent write its OWN reusable how-to skills, guided by the bundled self-improvement skill.
note: Always on — built-in core tools, shown here for reference.
skill_summary: Read this BEFORE improving yourself: the rules for when to save a reusable skill (save_own_skill) vs a fact in memory vs a durable change to your own prompt (edit_own_prompt) — e.g. when you build something reusable, work out a non-obvious procedure, or get a specific lasting instruction from the user.
